examples.english: and he said, Let me go, I pray thee, for we have a family sacrifice in the city, and my brethren have sent for me; and now, if I have found grace in thine eyes, I will even go over and see my brethren: therefore he is not present at the table of the king.

examples.coptic: ϫⲉⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲡⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲛⲁⲉⲣⲏⲧ ⲙⲡϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲏ ⲛϥⲱⲣⲕ ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲛⲁϣ ⲏ **ⲛϥⲧⲱϣ **ⲉ**ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲱϣ** ϩⲁⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲏ ⲛϥⲥⲱϣϥ ⲙⲡϥϣⲁϫⲉ ϣⲁϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲉⲧⲛⲏⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲛⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲡⲣⲟ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲉϥⲉⲁⲁⲩ
examples.english: Whatsoever man shall vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath, or bind himself with an obligation upon his soul, he shall not break his word; all that shall come out of his mouth he shall do.

examples.coptic: ⲁⲩⲱ ⲡⲗⲉⲩⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲁϥⲃⲱⲕ **ⲁϥⲧⲱϣ **ⲉ**ϭⲟⲓⲗⲉ** ⲉⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲁⲡϣⲏⲣⲉ ϣⲏⲙ ϭⲱ ϩⲁⲧⲏϥ ⲛⲧϩⲉ ⲛⲟⲩⲁ ⲛⲛⲉϥϣⲏⲣⲉ
examples.english: And the Levite went and began to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.
